# NYC MySchools

> NYC MySchools is the official public school admissions platform enabling families to explore, apply to, and enroll in New York City public schools.

MySchools serves as the central hub for NYC Department of Education school admissions, providing tools for school discovery, application submission, enrollment support, and access to admission events across all five boroughs. The platform helps families navigate the NYC public school system including specialized programs, gifted & talented tracks, and school tours.

## Key Topics

- School Admissions
- NYC Public Schools
- Enrollment Application
- Account Creation
- School Directory
- Event Calendar
- School Tours
- Admission Process
- Specialized High Schools
- Gifted & Talented Programs
- NYC Department of Education
- Student Portal
- School Fairs
- Enrollment Support

## Getting Started

- [NYC MySchools](https://myschools.nyc/en): NYC public school admissions platform for families to explore and apply to schools
- [Create an Account - NYC MySchools](https://myschools.nyc/en/account/create-account): Account creation page for MySchools platform registration and user onboarding

## Enrollment & Support

- [Enrollment Support Home Page](https://myschools.nyc/en/customer-portal): Enrollment support hub for NYC public schools admissions guidance and assistance

## Events & Discovery

- [MySchools Event Calendar - NYC MySchools](https://myschools.nyc/en/calendar): Event calendar for NYC school tours, fairs, and admission process events
